root_cause.text: A race in af_unix diagnostics let sk_diag_dump_vfs() access unix_sk(sk)->path.dentry without unix_state_lock, even though exact diag lookups only pin the socket and unix_release_sock() can concurrently clear u->path, leaving the VFS path data unstable.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that “Exact UNIX diag lookups hold a reference to the socket, but not to u->path” and that “unix_release_sock() clears u->path under unix_state_lock()”; the patch fixes this by moving reads of dentry, inode, and device in net/unix/diag.c under unix_state_lock() before emitting the netlink attribute.

intent_record.how: This makes access to the Unix socket path dentry occur under the socket state lock, preventing races while reading the VFS-related fields, and preserves the previous behavior of only emitting the UNIX_DIAG_VFS netlink attribute when a dentry exists.
